y7-u02-f4.a: A very narrow scale can make a small numerical difference look large.

y7-u02-f4.q: What must be kept the same when comparing temperature drops on two graphs?
y7-u02-f4.a: The time interval and comparable scales and conditions.

y7-u02-f4.q: What evidence supports a choice of insulation in a cooling test?

y7-u06-f3.q: How could an adaptation that helps find food affect reproduction?
y7-u06-f3.a: Better access to resources may support survival and the production of offspring.
